pages.text: $(bold)What it does:$(reset) forges Akaishi armor into $(reset)Life Fusion Armor$(reset).$(li)Input: one Akaishi Helmet/Chestplate/Leggings/Boots + one $(reset)Life Fusion Ingot$(reset)$(li)Costs $(bold)no energy$(reset)$(li)The result $(reset)keeps every upgrade on the original piece$(reset) — active upgrades and free slots carry over intact$(br2)The anvil accepts only the four Akaishi armor pieces.

pages.title: Where Fusion Ingots Come From
pages.text: $(bold)One source only$(reset): the Life Fusion Ingot has no crafting recipe — it can only be produced by the ritual at the $(l:akaishi:mother_altar)Altar of the Black Mother$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)Four results:$(reset) Life Fusion Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings and Boots.$(br2)Ingots are hard to obtain, so plan the upgrade order first; the chestplate usually yields the most benefit.

$(bold)Twice the strength:$(reset) Life Fusion Armor doubles the base stats of akaishi armor.$(li)Armor (boots/legs/chest/helm) $(reset)8 / 14 / 20 / 8$(reset), toughness $(reset)8$(reset), knockback resistance 0.2, enchantability 25$(li)Each piece worn: $(reset)+2$(reset) gene compatibility across all genes$(li)Full set (4 pieces): organ strength ×1.2, rejection grows ×0.75, damage can be offset by energy from portable cells (100 akaishi per point), and $(reset)free flight$(reset) — revoked when you take it off or leave creative/spectator mode$(br2)Endgame armor of the life line; preparation starts at the Mother Altar.
Stock transplant materials in the Organ Vault, obtain fusion ingots at the Mother Altar, then configure organs and traits.
